images.caption: Photograph of King Kalakaua aboard USS Charleston (C-2).  The cruiser was conveying His Majesty from Honolulu to San Francisco where the King intended seeking health. The vessel reached the Golden Gate December 4. With the King were the officers of the warship including Rear-Admiral George Brown and Captain George C. Remey. His aides Major Robert Hoapili Baker and Colonel George W. Macfarlane stand directly behind the King.
images.alt: Photograph of King Kalakaua aboard USS Charleston (C-2).  The cruiser was conveying His Majesty from Honolulu to San Francisco where the King intended seeking health. The vessel reached the Golden Gate December 4. With the King were the officers of the warship including Rear-Admiral George Brown and Captain George C. Remey. His aides Major Robert Hoapili Baker and Colonel George W. Macfarlane stand directly behind the King.
